# JebiTech Solutions Pvt. Ltd.

> Hospitality technology company building software products for vacation rental operators, hotels, and serviced apartments.

## Products

- **StayGuide**: Digital guest experience platform with local recommendations and self-service check-in tools.
- **StayFranchise**: Franchise management software for multi-location vacation rental operators.
- **OwnerHub**: Property owner portal for tracking bookings, revenue, and maintenance updates.
- **Booking Engine**: Direct booking engine to increase reservations and reduce OTA dependency.
- **VirtueInspect**: Property inspection and maintenance management for quality assurance.
- **Virtue Connect**: Channel management and connectivity for multi-platform distribution.
- **Virtue Finance**: Financial management and accounting automation for hospitality businesses.

## Services

- **Custom Development**: End-to-end software development tailored to hospitality needs.
- **Dedicated Teams**: Embedded engineering teams for ongoing hospitality technology projects.
- **Implementation & Integration**: System implementation, API integration, and platform migration.
